title: Building with Artifacts
description: Go deeper into Artifacts — build web pages, code projects, visualizations, and interactive tools with step-by-step guidance.

data.text: Building with Artifacts follows a simple pattern: describe what you want, Claude generates a first version, you review and request changes, and you iterate. The magic is that the iteration happens in plain English — you describe the change, Claude implements it in code. This is the closest thing to 'building software by describing it' that is widely available today.

HTML artifacts are the most versatile type. You can ask Claude to build landing pages, dashboards, forms, calculators, and interactive tools. Start with a clear description of what you want the page to do, who it is for, and how it should look.

data.title: Web page artifact prompt
data.content: Prompt: 'Create an HTML artifact for a personal project portfolio page. Include a hero section with my name and title, a projects grid with 3 placeholder projects, an about section, and a contact form. Use a modern, clean design with a blue and white color scheme. Make it responsive for mobile.'

data.text: Building a Python Data Analysis Artifact

Claude can generate Python scripts as artifacts that analyze data, create visualizations, or automate tasks. Describe the data you have, what analysis you want, and Claude builds the script. You can then copy the script to run it locally with your actual data.

data.title: Python data analysis artifact
data.content: Prompt: 'Create a Python artifact that reads a CSV file of sales data, calculates monthly totals, and generates a bar chart of sales by month. Include error handling for missing files. Use pandas and matplotlib.'

data.text: Interactive artifacts can include forms, calculators, to-do lists, budget trackers, and other tools. These are built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and run directly in the artifact panel. Describe the functionality you need, and Claude builds the interactive logic.

data.title: Step-by-step artifact building:
items: Start with a clear description of what you want to build
Ask Claude for an initial version as an artifact
Review the rendered artifact and identify what to change
Give specific feedback: 'Add a dark mode toggle', 'Make the form validate email addresses'
Iterate until the artifact meets your needs
Copy the code or download the artifact for use outside Claude

data.caption: The iterative artifact building cycle
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[Describe Goal] --> B[Claude Generates Artifact]
    B --> C[Review Rendered Output]
    C --> D[Give Specific Feedback]
    D --> E[Claude Updates Code]
    E --> C
    C -->|Satisfied| F[Copy / Download]

data.title: Proven patterns for effective artifact building:
items: Start simple, then add features one at a time
Use specific design references (colors, layouts, fonts)
Ask Claude to explain the code it generated — helps you understand and modify later
For data artifacts, provide a sample of the data structure
For web artifacts, specify responsive behavior and accessibility requirements

data.title: Building with Artifacts
